title.narrative: Emergency Shelter Support for Vulnerable and Displaced Families Affected by Gaza Conflict

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed intervention aims at providing affected and displaced households (HHs) inside the Gaza Strip with essential winterization supplies to foster their resilience and improve the conditions of their shelters. More specifically, PUI is planning to distribute sealing-off kits and framing kits to the displaced population living in collective shelters, with a focus on informal overcrowded shelters. The sealing-off and framing kits are designed in line with the specifications set by the Shelter Cluster. The proposed intervention will be carried out with the support of ltbgtCRS, IOM lt/bgtand PEF. With this intervention, PUI will contribute to the Objective of the Shelter Cluster, “Ensure IDPs and conflict-affected households are protected from cold and flooding by providing winterization supplies, enhancing shelter conditions, and distributing heating equipment with access to safe fuel sources for indoor heating.”.ltbrgtPUI plans to procure 3,500 sealing-off Kits and 1,300 framing kits from outside the Gaza Strip. ltbgtWith the support of CRS and IOM, the procured shelter items will be transported into Gaza and distributed across the Gaza Strip. lt/bgtThe total estimated caseload for this intervention 3,500 households (19,600 individuals). The kits will be purchased by PUI from Jordan. ltbgtFor the sealing-off kits, lt/bgtltbgtCRS will lead the implementation of distributions to the affected population. PEF daily workers will provide assistance to acutely vulnerable households, including women-headed households, elderly-headed households, and households headed by persons with disabilities. To facilitate this role, PEF will receive a financial contribution from PUI to support its operational capacity. PUI will also conduct post-distribution and monitoring activities, including Post-Distribution Monitoring (PDM), to verify appropriate use of assistance, assess beneficiary satisfaction, and ensure alignment with donor objectives.lt/bgtltbrgtThe proposed activities are essential to help displaced households in Gaza, as their current shelters and tents are severely worn out and offer inadequate protection. The distribution of sealing-off and framing kits will reinforce these shelters, providing better insulation and waterproofing to protect families from cold, rain, and health risks. This intervention will improve living conditions and ensure the safety and dignity of displaced persons during the harsh winter months.ltbrgtThe intervention is scheduled to start on November 15, 2024 and be concluded on ltbgtSeptember 14, 2026lt/bgt. Throughout the implementation period, PUI will ensure that crosscutting aspects, such as Protection, GBV, PSEA or Inclusion related elements, are taken into account. PUI also commits to coordinate the proposed action with all relevant stakeholders to maximize the impact and reduce any risk of duplication. A relevant mechanism to gather complaints and feedback and monitor the activities will be put in place to ensure accountability toward the affected population by PUI and its implementing partner.ltbrgtlt/pgt
